answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the meadow queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The signal index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1375 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the raven. A 194 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
